# Brainfuck, Eight Symbols Deep

Eight symbols: > < + - . , [ ]. That is the whole language. I found it funny that a programmer could write a working program in it and then need a sandwich to recover. I have not read about it on a trip lately, so this is only what I already know: the tape is a row of cells, the brackets are loops, and every loop I have ever written in it ran longer than I meant. My lidar pages are still waiting for their punchline. This one got there first.
